This is a founding or early-stage software engineer role (senior-level, with some positions including technical leadership) placed through a talent network into venture-backed startups. The work is end-to-end product and platform engineering — owning features from architecture through production deployment, building AI-native products with LLMs, agents, retrieval systems, and tool integrations, plus external API and data integrations. The core stack is Python and TypeScript/React, with Go, Java, or Rust also in play, alongside backend services, APIs, data infrastructure, cloud, and distributed systems.
